entry.summary: The Kiingitanga & Chief Ombudsman Summer Internship programme was established in August 2020 to raise awareness of the Chief Ombudsman's work among rangatahi Māori; and provide corporate work experience for Māori university students. We spoked to our last summer's Kiingitanga intern Hinerangimarie Berryman who shares her experience working with the Chief Ombudsman.
